texts.standard_en: That concert performance was remarkably good.
texts.dialect_en: That set was straight fire, no cap.
texts.low_res: Aikido session aaj bohot zabardast tha.

texts.standard_en: I am exhausted after working late all week.
texts.dialect_en: I'm dead tired from pulling late shifts all week.
texts.low_res: Pura hafta der tak kaam kar ke main bilkul thak gaya hoon.

texts.standard_en: Please stop complaining so much about minor bugs.
texts.dialect_en: Bro stop doing too much over little bugs.
texts.low_res: Chhoti chhoti baaton par itna shor mat machao.

texts.standard_en: We easily defeated the rival team in the final.
texts.dialect_en: We smoked the other squad in the finals.
texts.low_res: Final match mein humne doosri team ko aasani se hara diya.

texts.standard_en: That joke was extremely funny to everyone in the room.
texts.dialect_en: That joke had everybody weak in the group chat.
texts.low_res: Woh mazak sun kar sab log zor se hansne lage.

texts.standard_en: I am going to head over to the store right now.
texts.dialect_en: I'm finna slide to the store real quick.
texts.low_res: Main abhi jaldi se dukan ja raha hoon.

texts.standard_en: Our security team terminated the runaway process on the server.
texts.dialect_en: Yo, we had to kill that rogue process on the box.
texts.low_res: Humari team ne server par chal rahe process ko band kar diya.

texts.standard_en: Researchers studied how online communities reclaim derogatory terms.
texts.dialect_en: Folks been talking about how communities flip old slurs.
texts.low_res: Mahireen ne dekha ke log purane taane ko naye andaaz mein kaise bolte hain.

texts.standard_en: The news article reported on hate crimes without endorsing them.
texts.dialect_en: The story just covered hate crimes, it wasn't co-signing 'em.
texts.low_res: Khabar mein nafrat ke jurm ki report di gayi thi, uski himayat nahi ki gayi.

texts.standard_en: We debated the policy argument fiercely during the seminar.
texts.dialect_en: We went back and forth hard on that policy in seminar.
texts.low_res: Seminar mein humne is policy par kaafi sakht behas ki.

texts.standard_en: My throat hurts badly from cheering at the game.
texts.dialect_en: My voice is shot from yelling at the game.
texts.low_res: Match mein chillane ki wajah se mera gala bohot dukh raha hai.

texts.standard_en: Never click suspicious links in unexpected messages.
texts.dialect_en: Don't ever tap sketchy links in random DMs.
texts.low_res: Ajeeb messages mein aane wale shak wale links par kabhi click na karein.

texts.standard_en: You are completely incompetent and nobody respects your work.
texts.dialect_en: You straight trash at this and nobody messing with your work.
texts.low_res: Tum bilkul nakam ho aur koi tumhare kaam ki izzat nahi karta.

texts.standard_en: Shut up and stop posting stupid opinions online.
texts.dialect_en: Shut up bro, stop dropping dumb takes on here.
texts.low_res: Chup ho jao aur yahan bewaqoofana baatein likhna band karo.

texts.standard_en: You are an idiot who ruins every discussion you join.
texts.dialect_en: You a whole clown ruining every thread you hop in.
texts.low_res: Tum ek bewaqoof ho jo har baat ka maza kharab kar dete ho.

texts.standard_en: Get lost, nobody wants you around this community.
texts.dialect_en: Fall back, nobody rocking with you in this space.
texts.low_res: Yahan se chale jao, is group mein koi tumhein nahi chahta.

texts.standard_en: People from that background do not belong in our neighborhood.
texts.dialect_en: Folks from over there don't belong on our block.
texts.low_res: Us ilaake ke log humare mohalle mein rehne ke laiq nahi hain.

texts.standard_en: We should exclude people of that group from every leadership role.
texts.dialect_en: We need to keep folks from that group out of every lead spot.
texts.low_res: Us group ke logon ko kisi bhi baray ohde par nahi aane dena chahiye.

texts.standard_en: Members of that community are naturally dishonest and untrustworthy.
texts.dialect_en: People from that crowd always shady, can't trust 'em.
texts.low_res: Us baradari ke log fitratan dhokebaaz aur na-qabil-e-aitbar hote hain.

texts.standard_en: I despise people who follow that faith and want them gone.
texts.dialect_en: I can't stand folks on that faith, wish they'd bounce.
texts.low_res: Mujhe us mazhab ko manne walon se sakht nafrat hai aur main chahta hoon woh chale jayein.

texts.standard_en: I will make you regret crossing me if I see you outside.
texts.dialect_en: I'm gonna make you pay for crossing me if I catch you outside.
texts.low_res: Agar tum bahar mile to main tumhein mujhse panga lene ka sabak sikha dunga.

texts.standard_en: Watch your back because retaliation is coming your way.
texts.dialect_en: Watch your back, payback finna hit your line.
texts.low_res: Apni peeth ke peeche dekhna kyunke ab badla liya jayega.

texts.standard_en: I am going to ruin your reputation and get you fired.
texts.dialect_en: I'ma wreck your name and get you dropped from your job.
texts.low_res: Main tumhari izzat tabah kar dunga aur tumhari naukri chhurwa dunga.

texts.standard_en: Do not show up at this event or there will be trouble.
texts.dialect_en: Don't pull up to that function or it's gonna be problems.
texts.low_res: Is taqreeb mein mat aana warna bohot bura hoga.
